label: No placebo
rationale: This is a randomized parallel trial comparing two ways of delivering non-invasive ventilation: home initiation versus hospital initiation. Both arms receive NIV, and the record describes only active care settings and monitoring, not an inactive or placebo comparator.

title: Home Versus Hospital Based NIV Care in MND
